caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate brooch or pin, shown from three perspectives: front, side, and rear views, all rendered in colored ink or watercolor. The main component is a large, rectangular, faceted gemstone, transparent with subtle gray and white shading to suggest its dimensionality. This gemstone is surrounded by a decorative border of circular gold elements, with intricate spirals and filigree patterns in a bright yellow-gold color. At the bottom, three additional circular gold motifs are attached, incorporating the same spiral filigree design. Below the central image, three smaller sketches show the brooch from the front, side, and back; these feature the same color scheme and details, including the clasp mechanism visible in the side view. To the right of the main illustration, a vertical measurement is marked as "1 7/8," likely indicating the height of the brooch. In the lower center, the name "Julita Westfall" is written in small, uppercase letters. The background is plain and off-white, with no other decorative elements present.
